cases.name: Julie Kaye Cunningham
cases.about: She was a freshman at Western Michigan University. A scholarship was created in her honor called the Julie K. Cunningham Memorial Scholarship. A rock with a plaque bearing Julie Kaye Cunningham's name and the blue-spruce tree planted in her memory still stand in front of Western Michigan University's Siedschlag Hall, 25 years after her murder.
cases.narrative: He raped and murdered her when she was out for a run on Kanley Track.
